entities.name: Emil
entities.description: A gray-haired Wojek captain who grew up in Merrytown and investigates the burned tavern.

entities.name: Vatek
entities.description: A small, bony, self-important Wojek patrolman who wears a monocle and assists Emil.

entities.name: Orik
entities.description: A troll bouncer of the Titan's Keg, revived dead by Uzric's magemark, who tells the story of the tavern's destruction and explodes in fire.

entities.name: Uzric
entities.description: A Rakdos guildmage who wins the card game, scoops out his own eye, works on a cloak of flesh, and marks Orik with a magemark to deliver the tale.

entities.name: Yeep
entities.description: A crazy goblin regular at the Keg who bets his eye, tears off the elves' heads and juggles them.

entities.name: Ruk
entities.description: Yeep's brother, a goblin who plays a finger flute.

entities.name: Piggy
entities.description: A zombie regular at the Keg who dies fire-dancing and blocks the doors.

entities.name: Belko
entities.description: The bartender of the Titan's Keg.

entities.name: Jonik
entities.description: A baker Emil remembers from his childhood in Merrytown.

entities.name: Wojek
entities.description: The city's patrol force to which Emil and Vatek belong.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The guild of hedonistic cultists to which Uzric and the Keg's regulars belong.

entities.name: Elven strangers
entities.description: A party of travelling elves on a quest who are tortured and killed at the Keg.

entities.name: Merrytown
entities.description: A run-down part of the city whose name has become ironic.

entities.name: The Titan's Keg
entities.description: A two-story Merrytown tavern burned to the ground.

events.summary: Emil surveys the smoldering ruins of the Titan's Keg in Merrytown, his old neighborhood.
events.quote: Emil surveyed the smoldering ruins and felt the beginnings of a headache.

events.summary: Vatek reports that the only survivor wants to tell his story to the captain.
events.quote: We have only the one survivor, sir.

events.summary: Emil meets the survivor, a troll named Orik, the tavern's bouncer.
Orik says the card night's regulars included goblins, an imp, a zombie and the Rakdos guildmage Uzric.
events.quote: It was our regular card night at the Keg.

events.summary: A party of travelling elves enters the Keg, order drinks and huddle in a corner.
events.quote: this group of strangers come in, all elves

events.summary: Yeep wagers his own eye on a card hand and loses to Uzric; Uzric scoops out the eye and the imp feeds it to Yeep.
events.quote: Uzric was the one that did the eye scoopin’, but it was the imp that fed it to Yeep.

events.summary: The elves draw weapons and try to leave; Piggy is beheaded and another is skewered, and the patrons fight back.
events.quote: We thought them loppin’ Piggy’s head off was a joke

events.summary: The patrons kill one elf, tie up the others and torture them for hours with darts and a game called dentist.
events.quote: Them other elves, they didn’t die for hours, though.

events.summary: Yeep pulls the elves' heads off and later juggles them.
events.quote: all of a sudden he starts juggling the heads

events.summary: Emil's patrolmen quietly encircle Orik as the troll tells his tale.
events.quote: The patrolmen, meanwhile, had mostly completed a circle around the troll.

events.summary: A goblin sets the heads on fire, spilled bumbat ignites, and Piggy's fire-dancing blocks the doors, killing everyone inside.
events.quote: Anyways, the whole place went up in no time.

events.summary: Orik reveals Uzric appeared to him and etched a magemark so he could tell the Wojek what happened; Emil realizes Orik is dead.
events.quote: He etched a magemark on me so I’d be here talkin’ to you.

events.summary: Orik explodes in fire, starting a blaze that consumes nearly a third of Merrytown over three days.
events.quote: Over the next three days, the blast and resulting blaze would consume nearly a third of Merrytown.

relations.quote: Rakdos ,” Patrolman Vatek cursed behind him.

relations.note: Uzric used death magic to animate Orik and sent him with a message
relations.quote: Yeah, Uzric plays around with death magic a bit.

relations.note: Vatek is a patrolman who addresses Emil as sir
relations.quote: Sir. I was saying that the locals I questioned inform me that this was once a tavern.
I’m going to guess you were the bouncer here?
